posts.text:
🚨 Gayle King closes the door on the lesbian rumors between her and Oprah Winfrey and opens up on the day she found her ex-husband cheating with a former friend! @LorenLorosa  has the latest!

Video
What is the craziest way you found out your spouse was cheating? 👀 Let us know ⬇️ or Call in 800-585-1051💔

🚨 A landlord allegedly used his access to a tenant’s apartment to bring a woman over while the tenants were away and the entire encounter was caught on camera 👀 Was he completely wrong, or does owning the property change things? We took to the phone lines to discuss ⬇️

Video

🫏 Donkey Of The Day goes to a landlord who was supposed to be doing house repairs for his tenants while they were away, but was caught on camera using his tools for more than just repairs 😳. This landlord was caught in doing the naked tango for over an hour in their home! Tap into #DOTD, powered by @msllegal 🐂 #MichaelTheBull #TheBullNYC

Video

🚨 Drake breaks Michael Jackson’s record for the most #1 singles by a male solo artist 🎶 Debates online have already begun over whether Drake is bigger than Michael Jackson 👀 Tap into the latest w/ @lorenlorosa and let’s discuss ⬇️

Video

🚨 Marlon Wayans opens up about his relationship with Dave Chappelle and weighs in on the controversy surrounding Dave’s trans jokes, as many people questioned where Marlon stood since his son is trans. Tap into the latest w/ @LorenLorosa

Video
🚨 If your landlord was caught on camera getting cheeks in your apartment while you weren’t home, Are they wrong? They own the property? 👀 Let’s discuss. Call in 800-585-1051 or chat below ⬇️
🤔 Do you think you can control who your daughter dates? Call in 800-585-1051 or Drop your thoughts below ⬇️

🚨 Donkey Of The Day goes to Centennial & Franklin High in Franklin, Tennessee, for holding their graduation ceremony outside and forcing students to accept their diplomas 🎓 during a torrential downpour 🌧️! Why not take the ceremony inside??? Tap into #DOTD, powered by @msllegal 🐂 #MichaelTheBull #TheBullNYC

Video

🚨 What led to the reconciliation of @KevinHart4real  and Katt Williams? Kevin breaks down why they reconciled 8 months prior to the roast and how their beef was ultimately a waste of time. “I want nothing but the best for Katt.” Tap into the full conversation on @netflix

Video

🔊 @LorenLorosa got to the bottom of why the Cleveland Cavaliers allegedly took away Fat Joe’s courtside seats during the Knicks series. According to sources, Joe refused to sign waivers that limited how Knicks fans could support and react during the game 👀🏀 Tap in @lorenlorosa has the latest!

Video

🚨 @kevinhart4real addresses the conversation surrounding the downsizing of his HartBeat Production Company from the layoffs and more. Kevin details the decisions he’s made to continue ensuring the company’s longevity and pivoting in the market place. Check out the full conversation on @netflix!

Video

🚨 @KevinHart4real pulled up to The Breakfast Club and responded to the critics about his roast. “The George Floyd Joke wasn’t a tasteful joke”

Check out the full interview on @netflix

Video

💡 @jenniferarnise  breaks down the difference between survival versus healing. Jennifer explains how healing isn’t about changing the person you’re healing from — it’s about healing your perspective and the way you view yourself! Check out the full conversation on @netflix

Video

🚨 @jenniferarnise  is the newest addition to the @BlackEffectPods  network, and her podcast dives deep into “The Black Mother” and her agency in the world. Jennifer breaks down the disconnect that often exists between Black mothers and daughters, and how “The Black Mother Wound” can play a major role in parenting styles and generational relationships. Tap into the full conversation on @netflix

Video

🚨 @6LACK  music is raw, open, and transparent. He breaks down how the industry often treats vulnerability and explains how fatherhood has made him softer, more honest, and even more intentional in his music 🎶
Check out the full conversation on @netflix!

Video

Who is @6LACK ? 6lack made his way onto the scene out of Baltimore and explains his first introduction to music, what led him to create his unique sound, and his new project, ‘Love Is the New Gangsta.’ out now! Check out the full conversation on @netflix!

Video

🚨 @BODYBYJAKE has stayed authentic in fitness for decades! Jake breaks down the difference between real discipline and performative wellness, and explains how he uses his platform to help people take the first step toward a healthier lifestyle through music and wellness tips on iHeart Radio 💪🎶
